facts.overview: Set in 1955, French secret agent Hubert Bonisseur de La Bath/OSS 117 is sent to Cairo to investigate the disappearance of his best friend and fellow spy Jack Jefferson, only to stumble into a web of international intrigue.
facts.title: OSS 117: Cairo, Nest of Spies

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: What happened to Jack Jefferson in Cairo, and how deep does the conspiracy go once OSS 117 begins asking questions?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In 1955, French secret agent OSS 117 heads to Cairo to look into the mysterious disappearance of his fellow operative and close friend Jack Jefferson, quickly blundering into a dense web of international intrigue.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-moving, light, and exciting retro espionage comedy that delivers brisk fun without heavy emotional drag.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Michel Hazanavicius, this stylish action-comedy combines globe-trotting 1950s espionage with quick, witty humor and dynamic mid-century intrigue.
